anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Which filter policy should the report view apply when the user switches workspaces? The policy will be a key under the existing resolver (settings/resolver.ts:12) and read by ui/report-view.ts:30.
A) clear - every workspace switch clears all active filters
B) preserve - all active filters carry across every switch
C) restore per workspace - each workspace reopens with its own last-used filters
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler already keeps active filters, so making that the default changes nothing for current users and adds no per-workspace filter state.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:

The framing holds: checked the caller in app/start.ts:18, defaults in settings/resolver.ts:12, the resolver-to-view data path into ui/report-view.ts:30, and the workspace-change handler, which currently retains active filters without a selectable policy.

What should happen to filters when the workspace changes?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - preserves current behavior through the existing settings resolver without adding per-workspace filter storage.
